prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Finish new screen changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
Adoption redesign changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests, with 1 test stopped early due to worse adoption.
Adoption new screen changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for choose path redesign, finish new flow, finish redesign, home redesign, and sign-in hint changes.
Positive predictions were generally too high, though round 11 was underpredicted.
Negative predictions were too low, as all tests predicting negative results measured positive outcomes after noise correction.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: +0.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -2.5% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +11.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_flow: -2.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.4% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: +1.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 87.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Account Sync Status Hint: Adds a clear hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in ensures pets and progress are saved across logins. (why: 8 support emails mentioned pets being missing or reset after signing in again.)
1: [choose_path, layout] Path Selection Compact List Layout: Switches the path selection screen layout to a compact style for faster decision making. (why: The choose_path screen has a mean duration of 514s despite high conversion, indicating decision paralysis.)
2: [sign_in, redesign] Sign In Split Benefits Layout: Redesigns the sign-in screen into a split layout showcasing account backup benefits alongside options. (why: Sign-in conversion drops to 72.9% and multiple users experience account persistence confusion.)
3: [adoption, new_screen] Adoption Summary Prep Screen: Inserts a simple summary screen right before finalizing adoption to review chosen options. (why: Adoption step has the lowest step conversion at 60.9% and high dropoff time.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Initialization Status Indicator: Displays active status text and progress indicators on the waiting screen while rendering the pet. (why: The home/waiting stage takes a median 201s / mean 2336s, causing users to wonder if the app stalled.)
5: [finish, new_flow] Mascot Desktop Shortcuts Flow: Appends a quick onboarding sub-flow detailing basic desktop hotkeys and interactions. (why: 3 support tickets raised confusion about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.)
6: [finish, redesign] Home Welcome Stage Layout Redesign: Redesigns the home intro screen into a focused stage layout highlighting the final launcher action. (why: The finish step has 64.8% conversion with an extended mean time of 5815s.)
7: [adoption, copy] Pet Photo Clarity Guidance Copy: Updates photo upload instructions to explicitly clarify lighting and single-subject criteria. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual results.)
8: [sign_in, notification] Sign In Progress Loading Alert: Adds dynamic loading feedback and sign-in status updates on the login screen. (why: 2 support emails reported sign-in stalls or screens failing to appear.)
